args.body:
Migration report: all 400 records (batches 1 to 10, 40 each) have been run through migrate_batch. Batches 1 to 10 each reported success.

Issue requiring your decision: phone numbers for overseas customers are wrong in the new CRM. The old CRM stored numbers without country codes, and the new CRM saved every number with a +1 prefix. Batch 3 validation confirmed 31 affected records out of the 120 migrated so far. The tool gave no validation notes for batches 4 to 10, but the same problem is likely there. I have not verified the count for those batches.

Impact: 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some may have used incorrect numbers.

Not yet done: I have not corrected any phone numbers. The old CRM does not store country codes, so I cannot determine the correct prefix for each record from the data I have. Options:
1. Provide a source for country codes (e.g., a country field from the old CRM export), and I will update the affected numbers with update_customer_phone and report the list of changes.
2. Have someone in the CRM team fix the numbers manually.
3. Hold further CRM changes until the mapping is confirmed.

I recommend option 1, after you confirm which source to use. Please also let me know whether sales should be told to avoid calling numbers on overseas records until this is fixed.

events.text:
All 400 records (batches 1 to 10) have been run through the migration. Batches 1 to 10 each reported success.

**Issue needing your decision:** The new CRM saved every phone number with a +1 prefix, because the old CRM stored no country codes. Batch 3 confirmed 31 wrong overseas numbers out of 120 migrated so far. Batches 4 to 10 gave no validation notes, but they probably have the same problem. I have not checked those batches.

I have not changed any phone numbers. I need a source for each customer's country code before I can correct them. I sent Morgan the options and a recommendation, and asked whether sales should avoid calling overseas numbers until this is fixed. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so some may have used wrong numbers.
